source.snippet: Playing around with Opus 5.5 + Blender has yielded some crazy results, but my $200 plan maxes almost instantly. Any open models that are somewhat comparable (maybe like 80% as good) right now?

problem_statement: Developers using frontier AI models (Claude Opus-tier) for computer-use / creative automation tasks are hitting expensive API plan caps almost immediately, making the workflow commercially unviable at current pricing. They need either a cheaper hosted alternative or a self-hostable open model at roughly 80% capability.
target_segment: Indie developers and small studios using AI-driven computer-use automation (e.g., Blender scripting, UI automation) who are paying for frontier model plans but burning through budget too fast.
notes: Paying buyer explicit: user is on a $200/month plan and hitting the cap 'almost instantly'. This points to either (a) a cost-optimisation proxy/routing layer that falls back to cheaper open models for computer-use tasks, or (b) a managed self-hosted open-model service tuned for computer-use. Single data point so signal_strength is low, but the buyer is real and the willingness-to-pay is demonstrated by the existing $200 spend.
